data.name: Raiyaan
data.gender_notes: Raiyaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who tends and nurtures gardens, symbolizing growth and prosperity. The name Raiyaan carries the meaning “Nurturing Gardener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Raiyaan usually hope their child will grow to embody nurturing gardener and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran mentions gardens as a metaphor for paradise, making Raiyaan a spiritually significant name.
data.etymology: Raiyaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nurturing Gardener.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raiyaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: رَيَّان
in_arabic.meaning: باب الجنة للصائمين، الباب الرابع للجنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَيَّان هو باب من أبواب الجنة، خصص للصائمين، ورد في الحديث الشريف: «في الجنة ثمانية أبواب، منها باب يسمى رَيَّان، لا يدخله إلا الصائمون»

in_urdu.name: رایان
in_urdu.meaning: صائموں کے لئے جنت کا ایک خاص دروازہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: رایان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'جنت کا دروازہ' یا 'صائموں کے لئے جنت کا خاص دروازہ'۔ یہ نام قرآن و حدیث میں ذکر ہوا ہے، خاص طور پر صائموں کے لئے جنت میں ایک خاص مقام کی اشاره کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रायान
in_hindi.meaning: व्रत रखने वालों के लिए जन्नत का एक विशेष द्वार
in_hindi.long_meaning: रायान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'जन्नत का द्वार' या 'व्रत रखने वालों के लिए जन्नत का विशेष द्वार'। यह नाम कुरआन और हदीस में उल्लेखित है, विशेष रूप से व्रत रखने वालों के लिए जन्नत में एक विशेष स्थान की ओर संकेत करता है

in_pashto.name: رېيان
in_pashto.meaning: د روژې د لمانځونکو لپاره جنت يو ځانګړی دروازه
in_pashto.long_meaning: رېيان د عربي نوم دی چې مطلب يې 'جنت دروازه' يا 'د روژې د لمانځونکو لپاره جنت خاص دروازه' ده. دا نوم په قرآن او حديث کې ياد شوی، په ځانګړي ډول د روژې د لمانځونکو لپاره په جنت کې يو ځانګړي مقام ته اشاره کوي

in_english.name: Raiyaan
in_english.meaning: A special gate of Paradise for those who fast
in_english.long_meaning: Raiyaan is an Arabic name that refers to a specific gate of Paradise reserved for those who observe fasting. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'r-y-n', it signifies a gate in Paradise exclusively for those who fast during Ramadan. This name is mentioned in Hadith, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition as a reward for the righteous and steadfast in their faith

data.cultural_impact: The name "Raiyaan" has its roots in the beautiful and essential aspect of Islamic culture, which is the nurturing and cultivation of gardens. Gardens in Islamic culture are symbolic of paradises and represent the idea of growth and prosperity. This name can evoke feelings of serenity and a deeper appreciation for the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Raiyaan" reflects the concept of serving and nurturing the creations of Allah. This name embodies the dynamic between the caretaker and the cared-for, emphasizing the importance of stewardship and the interconnected web of existence. Muslims who bear this name are encouraged to further cultivate their own spirits, care for their communities, and strive for growth and prosperity in their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Nurturing Gardener" symbolizes One who tends and nurtures gardens, symbolizing growth and prosperity.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raiyaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of nurturing gardener.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Raiyaan ibn Shammasah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and took part in several battles.
